messages:
maria: Heads-up — customer 'AtlasHealth' wants the private rollout activation this Thursday 03:00 UTC. They need a 30m quiet window for fw changes + artifact sync. Can owners confirm blockers?

aj: I can own the fw-change window. Need exact ACL lines from customer networking before I book the CR.

maria: @aj noted. Customer said they will open a ticket with the ACLs tonight.

devon: Quick question — does the quiet window need any special on-prem image sync before we flip routes? last time we had stale certs.

sylvie: Yes — we need the signed artifacts and the image checksum verified. I'll push the signed bundle to the airgap registry and post the sha256.

kevin: Who has bastion access to run the smoke curl after cutover? I can take it but need the jump-host creds rotated first.

aj: I'll rotate the creds and add @kevin to the bastion group. Rotation scheduled at 02:45 UTC.

devon: Is telemetry egress already verified for this tenant? we need health pings to succeed or the prober will alert.

oncall-prober: prober: Tenancy AtlasHealth currently has egress blocked to telemetry endpoints (500s). Flagging a preflight failure.

sylvie: ack. I'm coordinating with customer to allow telemetry.egress.redwood.ai on port 443 for the duration.

maria: Can we list the owners for each step so ops knows who to DM during the window?

aj: Network ACLs / CR owner: aj. Bastion creds: aj. Bastion smoke: kevin. Artifact push / signing: sylvie. Canaries + prober: devon + oncall-prober. Post-cutover rollback owner: maria.

kevin: I'll create a tiny smoke check to run from bastion after route flip: `curl -sS -D - https://atlas.health/api/health | head -n 20` — will check cert chain + 200.

devon: add this quick preflight: run `openssl s_client -connect atlas.health:443 -servername atlas.health` and confirm the cert CN + chain and that we can establish TLS from our staging egress.

sylvie: posting sha256 and image path now: `s3://airgap/atlas/2026-03-18/bundle.tar.gz` sha256=`b1946ac92492d2347c6235b4d2611184`. Customer confirmed artifact signature via GPG.

oncall-prober: prober: will re-run telemetry probe at 02:30 UTC after ACL update. If still failing, I'll escalate to eng-sre.

maria: timeline proposal: 02:30 ACL lift and prober check; 02:45 bastion creds rotate; 02:50 artifact verification; 03:00 route flip; 03:05 smoke curls + prober check; 03:30 finalize and close CR. Any objections?

aj: timeline looks good. I'll post the CR number when created: CR-4182.

kevin: no objections. I'll be on-call for the smoke run.

devon: FYI I'll be pulling logs into the temporary bucket `s3://rollouts/atlas/` — please don't wipe until final signoff.

sylvie: done. also added a short runbook snippet in the CR describing the rollback: revert route table + redeploy previous image.

maria: perfect. tagging @ops-bot to create an incident channel for the window and to send reminder at 02:15 UTC.

ops-bot: incident-bot: Created channel #inc-atlas-1745551111 and scheduled reminder at 02:15 UTC.

aj: CR-4182 created and linked in channel. Putting the ACL patch here for reference:

```
allow tcp from 10.32.0.0/16 to 54.210.34.10/32 port 443 comment "telemetry.egress.redwood.ai"
allow tcp from 10.32.0.0/16 to 35.199.80.0/24 port 443 comment "artifact registry"
```

maria: OK — looks good. I'll DM execs a short heads-up after we finish the preflight. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
